product.name: Pawsome Catnip Sachet 50g
product.description: Pawsome Catnip Sachet 50g delivers a fresh, aromatic experience for indoor cats. The sachet contains 50 grams of premium, hand‑picked catnip leaves, harvested without synthetic pesticides or herbicides. Packaged in a resealable paper pouch with a food‑grade plastic seal, the product preserves aroma and moisture for extended use. Each sachet is lightweight and portable, making it ideal for travel, playtime, or routine enrichment. The packaging includes a simple care guide and a QR code linking to interactive feeding suggestions, ensuring responsible and enjoyable use.
